gate_status: FAILED on the proxy: the worst recording's p95 is about 250 ms in five independent runs of the unchanged detector, and four of six recordings exceed 200 ms.

retained_changes.evidence: 0 changed compared fields; same predicate, buffered scatter.

rejected_candidates.name: exact cell grid inside native within_radius
rejected_candidates.reason: Measured need absent: on doubleT_obstacle the caller makes 88 calls per recording with at most 96 x 96 pairs, 1.7 ms in total, largest single call 0.033 ms. The index would cost more than it saves; reverted.

rejected_candidates.name: box-maintaining footprint merge in the running-surface split
rejected_candidates.reason: Measured input size: 151 calls over 201 scans, median 2 and maximum 10 child groups, so the rebuild it replaced was already trivial. Reverted as unmeasured complexity.

rejected_candidates.name: fewer odometry or query threads to stop starving the serial path
rejected_candidates.reason: Five allocations measured on the same recording (odometry 8/6/4/2 threads x query 8/4 workers): p50 191.8-195.4 ms, p95 249.9-252.1 ms. No effect; the detector is not CPU-starved by the motion thread.

rejected_candidates.name: nanoflann for exact nearest-neighbour queries
rejected_candidates.reason: Preserved real split inputs: about 1.0-1.2 ms saved per build/query on the five largest pairs, with no mismatched index. Too little total benefit to justify a new dependency in the required build.

rejected_candidates.name: external GPU clustering kernels (cuda_cone_rush, cuPCL, cuML DBSCAN)
rejected_candidates.reason: None preserves the adaptive mutual-radius edges, running-surface support and instance behaviour this detector's decisions rest on; none was substituted.

attribution_this_host_ms_per_scan.note: Inclusive, overlapping, scene-specific; not additive. Local CPU and remote CUDA backends agree on the ordering of the consumers.

tail_findings.flat_costs: Segment-plane, KD-tree build, voxel down-sample, rail profile, structural mask, robust plane and motion are flat across the p95 band (delta <= 0.1 ms), so the tail is not the geometry stage.
tail_findings.unexplained: cluster_objects reached 61.3-62.6 ms on 8 of 201 scans (median 6.04, p95 7.46) with identical input sizes (cloud 22.9k-24.7k, 1417-1591 labels, 273-330 accepted components). A ten-fold stall at constant size is not an algorithmic term; the retained explanation is host-side scheduling or memory stalls, which no algorithmic change in this iteration addresses.
tail_findings.nondeterminism: The slowest frames differ between runs of the same recording (overlap only partial), consistent with host noise rather than a per-frame property of the data.
